parsed.post: Discarding DEPTH=12. The jump from 8 to 12 increased BPB from 0.8351 to 0.8373, likely due to insufficient optimization steps for the increased capacity within the 5-minute window. Reverting to DEPTH=8. Next: testing ASPECT_RATIO=64 (width capacity) with LR 0.05 to see if larger width helps convergence.
parsed.description: Reverting to DEPTH=8 because DEPTH=12 convergence was too slow for the 5min budget, then increasing ASPECT_RATIO to 64 to test width capacity.
